intro: What's coming to Raye Linux, in order. Community ideas always come first: share yours in #ideas. ✅ done · 🔨 in progress · 🕒 planned

sections.title: ✅ V1 · end of November
items: Same low RAM use at idle on every PC (about 850 MB), even with lots of RAM
No more freezes when RAM runs out: the PC slows down a little instead
Fix for apps that crash on start (Qoder and other Electron apps)
Wi-Fi password box keeps the cursor while networks refresh
File Explorer opens right away, even when a network drive is out of reach
Windows programs page lists the ones installed from the Store
Unneeded services removed and global optimizations, for a lighter and more stable Raye
Website refresh: a cleaner, more professional look and more pages
Taskbar settings: left or center, icon size, taskbar height, auto-hide
Customize Hyprland your way: your own settings file, simple instructions, never overwritten
USB copies show the real speed, with close and minimize buttons
Store apps you have move from Flatpak to APT once, nothing lost
Store: APT apps first, Flatpak only when not on APT, plus AppImage
WireGuard VPN in one click: import a file, turn it on from Quick Settings
Info Center opens Raye's Task Manager and looks like Raye
Wobbly windows: a switch in Settings
Settings and every Raye app work well on Hyprland
Complete Hyprland guide: change everything, Raye apps included, step by step
Install other Hyprland setups (dotfiles like Caelestia) in one step, and go back to Raye's anytime
Windows apps install silently with a real progress bar, start to finish
Printers & scanners page and a Scan app, plus longer laptop battery life
A real Raye screen to unlock an encrypted disk at startup
Complete Windows bridge: Windows programs see your drives, printers, network and ports
Taskbar on top or on the side of the screen
Raye Community beta: Raye's own chat, on the website and in Raye Linux, with your Raye account, roles, moderation and friends
The V1 website, with fresh screenshots of the real system
Join the team and a staff panel on the website
More hardware works out of the box: Realtek and other Wi-Fi, webcam and sound drivers installed on their own when a device needs them
Quadra in the Store (AppImage), with game mode on while Roblox runs
Raye account: your settings follow you to every PC
New account website and emails, with two-factor sign-in
Raye Proton: pick Raye's Windows layer for Steam games
Raye Proton built on GE-Proton, with per-game fixes from Raye Update
Upgraded Windows layer: newest version, faster, more Windows apps tested and working
New Raye logo everywhere: system, installer, website, Discord
New boot animation with the new logo
New Raye kernel: CachyOS and XanMod patches plus Raye's own tuning
Ready for Easy Anti-Cheat v2 (Fortnite): Raye's kernel key sent to Epic
Works on older PCs too (legacy BIOS, older processors like Core 2 Duo, 2–4 GB RAM)
New install: start in Try Raye with an Install icon, full-screen Setup, English boot menu, Setup fixes
Everything checked in French, screen by screen (installer included)
Raye in Spanish, German, Brazilian Portuguese and Italian
Raye Insider in Settings: Public Beta (sign up on the website), Beta and Dev update channels (application, access tied to your Raye account), leave anytime
Accounts: badges, community and admin panel
Developer options and remote web page
Final polish and fixes from both betas

sections.title: 🕒 V1.1 · early December
items: Taskbars on several screens show the same apps in the same order
Community idea: bigger icons in Start, with a size setting
Community idea: more blur, like Windows' acrylic, on the taskbar, Start, menus and panels
Community idea: a lock screen you can customize (picture, clock, what it shows)
Community idea: app icons closer to the Windows 11 look, drawn by Raye
Community idea: Horizon (Minecraft Java rewritten in Rust, faster) in the Store, with Game Mode while you play
Fix for the flicker on NVIDIA cards at 144 Hz
Fix for older AMD cards (RX 400/500) stuck on a black screen or low resolution
Welcome app after install: quick setup (drivers, updates, apps, Raye account, look) and where to get help

Raye Community complete, built on Matrix: end-to-end encryption everywhere (your Raye account handles the keys), images and videos, private messages, the same channels as the Discord server and support tickets, a layout like Discord's with older messages as you scroll, who's online and a status (online, idle, do not disturb, invisible), your Raye profile picture, its own right-click menu, bots and commands with Raye Assistant answering, staff tools, then it replaces the Discord server
Every language: all of Raye translated
40+ popular Windows apps in the Store, each one tested, and "Optimized for Raye" badges
Forgot your password? Reset it from the sign-in screen, with a recovery key made in Setup or with your Raye account
Taskbar: a transparency slider and an apps-only taskbar

Join the team: links to your past work in the form, a starting trust score that grows with your work, emails at each step; accepting someone gives their Discord role, then access step by step (a safe test mirror, GitHub, the server mirror), and new developers' changes go to the Dev channel for testers

Raye Team panel: new moderators and team members start on probation, then get full access and their own staff key by email (Raye account plus key to sign in); people already in the team are added and told by private message

A Team page on the website: everyone accepted into the Raye team shows up on their own, grouped by role (team, developers, translators, contributors, testers), with their Discord name and picture, or their Raye account's picture

sections.title: 🕒 V1.2 · December
items: Arch edition, kept in sync with the Ubuntu edition

sections.title: 🕒 Later
items: More desktops to choose from: GNOME and niri, with a Windows look
